 내가 주님을 그리워 하는데

 你也会想念我吗?

title: I Saw You
lyrics:
I always thought i owned the world.
 

 I used to gamble my life with these silly things.

 when my castle crumbled down i found the most important thing.
 

 I saw you, I saw you, I saw You.
 

 

 Chorus:
 

 

 Don't ask for miracles just look within yourself.
 

 It's the life you have, the life he saved when he died from the cross.
 

 He made the skies and earth for us to live
 

 He's my shepherd, I'll follow his lead.
 

 alpha and omega.
 

 Nothing's impossible for him.
 

 

 II:
 

 

 The beaten and the damned will be saved.
 

 He'll pave a path for all the people that has lost their way.
 

 He's the epitome of being good.
 

 When everything you know has fallen.
 

 He'll be there for you, for you.
 

 

 Bridge:
 

 

 From being in the dark now i'm safe in His light.
 

 a boy that was scared now a man who will fight.
 

 for the things that i believe in, oh I'll carry your mission.
